_comment: Networks that chainid.network does not list as mainnets. rpc is used by verify_onchain.py instead of the chainlist RPCs, and only for this chainId. mainnet true means the entry may be kept when no RPC answers.

networks.name: HyperEVM
sources: https://hyperliquid.gitbook.io/hyperliquid-docs/for-developers/hyperevm : 'Chain ID: 999', 'JSON-RPC endpoint: https://rpc.hyperliquid.xyz/evm for mainnet', 'HYPE is the native gas token on the HyperEVM'
eth_chainId on https://rpc.hyperliquid.xyz/evm returns 0x3e7 (999), checked in this run
networks.note: chainlist.org lists chainId 999 only as Wanchain Testnet, so chainlist RPCs are not used for this chainId. Decimals of the native token are not on-chain data; 18 is the EVM default and is stated for HYPE by no source read in this run.
